about: Esther tells how a brave young queen saved her people.

pages.title: A New Queen
pages.text: The king of Persia was looking for a new queen. He chose a beautiful young woman named Esther. She was Jewish, but she kept it secret. Her cousin Mordecai, who raised her, still checked on her every day.
pages.lesson: God has a plan for your life.

pages.title: For Such a Time as This
pages.scene: Mordecai talking to Esther outside the palace
pages.text: A mean man named Haman tricked the king into making a law to hurt all the Jewish people. Mordecai told Esther, "Maybe you became queen for such a time as this!" Going to the king without being called was dangerous. But Esther said, "I will go."
pages.lesson: Be brave and speak up for others.

pages.title: Esther Saves Her People
pages.scene: Queen Esther at dinner pointing at Haman before the king
pages.text: Esther invited the king and Haman to a dinner. Then she told the king about Haman's plan. The king was angry with Haman! He made a new law so the Jewish people could be safe. Everyone celebrated with a happy feast called Purim.
pages.lesson: God can turn sad things into joy.
